title: EPS bearer context deactivation initiated by the network

entities.name: Network-initiated EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: Procedure where the MME initiates deactivation of EPS bearer contexts, either with NAS signaling when connection exists or locally when no connection exists.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE to initiate EPS bearer context deactivation. Contains ESM cause and may include PTI, EPS bearer identity, and other IEs.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network in response to DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, confirming deactivation.

entities.name: T3495
entities.description: Timer started by MME when sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, stopped upon receiving DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State entered by MME after sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and starting T3495.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: IE included in DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST indicating reason for deactivation. Common values: #8 (operator determined barring), #29 (user authentication/authorization failed), #112 (APN restriction incompatible), #113 (multiple accesses not allowed).

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: PTI value included in DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when deactivation is triggered by UE-initiated bearer resource modification or PDN disconnect procedures.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: IE included in DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when deactivating all EPS bearer contexts of a PDN connection (identity of default bearer).

entities.name: WLAN offload indication
entities.description: IE that shall not be included when deactivating all EPS bearer contexts of a PDN connection. If received, UE shall ignore it.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection exists
entities.description: Condition determining whether MME initiates deactivation with NAS signaling (if true) or locally (if false).

entities.name: Local deactivation without NAS signaling
entities.description: Behavior where MME locally deactivates EPS bearer context towards UE when no NAS signalling connection exists.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message when NAS signalling connection exists.
Procedure starts timer T3495 when sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.
Procedure requires entering BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE PENDING state after sending request.
Message contains ESM cause IE indicating deactivation reason.
Message contains PTI when triggered by UE-initiated procedures.
Message contains EPS bearer identity when deactivating all bearers of a PDN connection.
Message shall not contain WLAN offload indication when deactivating all bearers of a PDN connection.
Receiving DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT stops timer T3495.
When NAS signalling connection does not exist, MME performs local deactivation without peer-to-peer signaling.
Presence of NAS signalling connection determines whether DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST is sent.
